q: How does a Kanpur tannery count the chrome and chemicals it buys?
title: Kanpur tanneries: bought tanning chemicals
short: Basic chromium sulphate, fatliquors, dyes and other chemicals bought for tanning are Scope 3 category 1 purchased goods. Use kilograms from the invoices and a factor from the supplier or a named database, with the source on each line.
audience: Tanneries in the Jajmau cluster of Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh

p: Record kg per chemical from each invoice.
Note the factor, its unit and where it came from.
Keep chemicals separate from hides, which are their own purchased-goods line.
Boiler fuel and generator diesel are Scope 1; grid electricity is Scope 2. Effluent sent to the common treatment plant is Scope 3 category 5.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
